note: RFC-0026 development profile (RFC-0018 A1, A2): no security level, FS unproven, PCS conjectural, no zero-knowledge. Prover time is the prove-dev process wall time: Artifact decode, weight commitment, executor capture (witness), plain check and proof. In-process stage timings (stage_times_ns, RFC-0018 A2) time model_commitment (running beside the executor passes of stage witness under std; the weight decode is counted in both), witness, plain_check (running beside the relation engine under std), plan, commitment (overlapping multiplicity counting in parallel::join), multiplicities, zerochecks, lookups, reductions and openings; witness_recompute_ns equals stage witness. On Linux with glibc the CLI runs with GLIBC_TUNABLES=glibc.malloc.hugetlb=1 unless that variable is already set (ADR-159); this harness refuses an environment that holds STELE_HUGE_PAGES_EXEC, which would stop the CLI from setting it. Verifier time is the verify-dev process wall time. CPU only, no GPU; threads is the hardware thread count available to the process. Peak RSS is the GNU time -v maximum resident set size. Controls are the four statement tampers of rejects_tampers_on_a_supplied_proof against this proof, each rejected by the verifier with the header restamped. Not comparable to W1-W8 records; not a cost-model fit input.
